question: For the calendar year 2021, what is the overall average quantity sold of the top three best-selling hardware products (by total quantity sold) in each division?
sql:
WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT division, product_code, total_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY total_qty DESC) as rn
    FROM (
        SELECT p.division, s.product_code, SUM(s.sold_quantity) as total_qty
        FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
        JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code = p.product_code
        WHERE s.date >= '2021-01-01' AND s.date <= '2021-12-31'
        GROUP BY p.division, s.product_code
    )
    QUALIFY rn <= 3
)
SELECT division, AVG(total_qty) as avg_quantity_sold
FROM top3
GROUP BY division
ORDER BY division
